subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The remaining change defines stable semantics for exact versus estimated cost, units/source, raw cost_details, persistence, and agent-facing API shape; automation should not choose that product/API contract.

options.title: Define Additive Exact-Cost Metadata
options.body: Add separate provider-reported cost fields with source and units, then thread them through transcript/session/runtime/status surfaces while preserving existing local estimates.

options.title: Limit Core To Local Estimates
options.body: Keep OpenClaw's core cost surfaces estimate-based and point exact OpenRouter charge display to a plugin or external accounting layer.

options.title: Defer To Broader Usage API
options.body: Leave this issue open but fold the implementation into a broader structured session usage API such as the related session_status usage work.

recommendation.title: Define Additive Exact-Cost Metadata
recommendation.body: Add separate provider-reported cost fields with source and units, then thread them through transcript/session/runtime/status surfaces while preserving existing local estimates.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation, usage-cost reporting, and the runtime/session files that would define the contract.
